Scores describe data variation and support exploration; they do not measure disease risk or clinical confidence. Groups follow the input codes. Clinical stages are not inferred without supplied definitions.

Click a node or sector to inspect its original data
RingNet help

Drag nodes to reposition them. Drag the background to pan, and use the mouse wheel or a two-finger gesture to zoom.

Click a node to inspect a gene. Click a sector in a network ring or the enlarged ring on the right to see its sample name in the inspector and inspect its values.

All directed edges use the same large arrowhead; shaft width still represents edge weight. Use Background above the canvas to switch between black (default) and white. PNG, SVG and JSON preserve the arrow style and background.

Use the left-hand menu to open filters, colors, and layout settings. The inspector on the right can be collapsed.

JSON files can use the original community_map_top100.json format. Sample IDs must be supplied through sample_ids, sample_names, patient_ids, or samples metadata. Otherwise, samples are identified by their array index.

All demo data are synthetic. An error is displayed if session data cannot be loaded.
